race.title: Follow Dave Win 60th Birthday Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: DOCTORS HILL made a pleasing start to his chase career at Ffos Las and is given a chance to build on that promise, particularly as hat-trick seeker Royal Mer has peak fitness to prove after a break. Ben Pauling chase newcomer The Hawkstonian and Venetia Williams French recruit Luron d'Oudairies are other interesting runners. DOCTORS HILL ROYAL MER (FR) THE HAWKSTONIAN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Royal Mer (3/1), Mr Mojo Risin (9/2), The Hawkstonian (5/1), Luron D'oudairies (6/1), Doctors Hill (6/1), A Moments Madness (7/1), Kourosh (14/1), Whiskeywealth (16/1), Locquirec (20/1)
